values.note: One rate for everyone: 'May 15th – September 15th: $45.00 per day' (county page); the booking site quotes $45 for 2026-07-14 and 2027-07-13. No resident/non-resident difference and no park entry or parking fee.

fees.source: https://muskegoncountyparks.org/blue-lake-park/ ('Campsite Fee: May 15th – September 15th: $45.00 per day', 'Overnight Campsite Fee: $45/night', 'There are no parking fees at Blue Lake Park') + https://muskegoncounty.goingtocamp.com/ (Blue Lake County Park campsites, /api/resource/feeDetails 2026-07-14 and 2027-07-13 = 45.0; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://muskegoncountyparks.org/blue-lake-park/ ('25 modern campsites, offering both open and shaded sites with water and electric hookups') + https://muskegoncounty.goingtocamp.com/ (all 25 campsites: 'Electrical Service=20/30/50 amp'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Allowed equipment on the booking site: 10 sites take trailers/RVs up to 45 ft, 1 up to 35 ft, 9 up to 20 ft, and 5 are listed for tents and truck campers only. Open and shaded sites.

sites.source: https://muskegoncountyparks.org/blue-lake-park/ ('25 modern campsites') + https://muskegoncounty.goingtocamp.com/ (allowedEquipment per site), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Modern restroom with flush toilets and ADA-accessible showers; sanitary dump station. Check in and buy firewood and ice at the Park Office north of the bathhouse (run by the Blue Lake caretaker).

facilities.source: https://muskegoncountyparks.org/blue-lake-park/ ('The campground includes a modern restroom with flush toilets, ADA-accessible showers and a sanitary dump station. Campers can check in and purchase firewood and ice at the Park Office'), read 2026-10-25

season.source: https://muskegoncountyparks.org/blue-lake-park/ ('Blue Lake Park is closed September 15 to May 15'; 'Campsite Fee: May 15th – September 15th'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online ('Make a Reservation' on the county page); ADA campsites are reserved by email or phone to Park Headquarters (231-744-3580). Check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://muskegoncountyparks.org/blue-lake-park/ ('Make a Reservation' -> muskegoncounty.goingtocamp.com; 'Please email or call our Park Headquarters to reserve an ADA campsite') + https://muskegoncountyparks.org/camping-rules/ ('Check-out time is at 1:00 p.m.'), read 2026-10-25

note: Muskegon County park on Big Blue Lake (10701 Nichols Rd, Holton): campground just east of the small day-use area with its swimming beach on 600 ft of shoreline. The Deremo boat launch is 1.5 miles north. --Claude
summary: County page + GoingToCamp: 25 sites with water and 20/30/50-amp electric (electric now 50), $45/night for everyone (2026 and 2027, confirmed; no resident split, no entry fee), rigs to 45 ft (added), flush toilets/showers/dump, season May 15 - Sept 15 (confirmed), reservable on GoingToCamp. Phone 231-894-5574 (Blue Lake Park) matches. Note trimmed of field restatements. Not stated: sewer, booking window.
